native_relationships: Create all issues first; attach each child with GitHub native sub-issues, then add native blocked-by relationships in a second pass. Issue numbers/node IDs will be recorded only after actual creation.
publication_gate: docs/agents/issue-tracker.md: Do not publish until the ticket breakdown is approved.
paid_execution_gate: No new inference budget or resource limits are approved by this draft.
approval: Owner approved publishing the map, 13 children, dependencies and evidence branch; requested sane, bounded grilling.
grilling_policy: Keep grilling bounded: ask at most three consequential questions in an initial round, with recommended defaults. Ask a followup only if an answer blocks the next benchmark/prototype or materially changes cost, quality, or scope. Use provisional defaults for reversible details; defer refinements until results reveal a need. Stop once the next experiment can run responsibly. Do not require an exhaustive taxonomy, final architecture, or every attribute decision before a first useful comparison.
